method: Measured on 2026-10-25 by pnpm perf:budgets --template astro --runs 5: the Astro template built for production (astro build) and served by astro preview against a seeded API; Lighthouse (mobile preset) loaded /; scriptBytes is the sum over the page's script requests of gzip(body) at zlib's default level. astro preview does not compress, so the wire size is the raw size.
